description: Elder Maren, an elderly woman cleric with long silver-white hair, a violet robe with gold embroidery, a white and gold mantle over her shoulders, holding a tall wooden staff topped with a gold ring. JRPG field sprite in the style of Xenogears on the PlayStation: soft painterly pixel shading, no black outlines (dark lines are deep shades of the colours beside them), muted rich palette, slender anime proportions about four heads tall, ornate fantasy class costume with layered cloth and gold trim, standing relaxed.
